item.title: Can foreigners be landlords and rent out property in Thailand?
item.description: Yes, foreigners can be landlords in Thailand, but preferably only through legal channels, as Thai law prohibits direct land ownership by foreigners. However, several legitimate structures allow you to own or control property and earn rental income from it.
